precision: bfloat16 autocast with float32 parameters and optimizer; float32 evaluation
test_policy: Evaluate only after every planned run has selected and locked its checkpoint using validation.
initialization: Within each seed, all single-layer variants copy the same raw initial weights; multilayer variants copy the same pretrained backbone and initialized classifier. Fixed unit LayerNorm affine buffers intentionally differ.
sampling: Each epoch has a fixed independent permutation, shared by variants within a dataset and seed.
fine_tune_parent: Validation-selected corrected vanilla checkpoint from the same seed; no historical buggy checkpoint is reused.
selection: Highest validation metric after a completed epoch; first epoch wins ties; epoch zero is diagnostic only.
data: Preserve all official test rows. Remove exact/reverse-complement/effective-token duplicates from lower-priority splits; genomic validation is 10% of training groups with split seed 20261112.
protocol_changes_from_legacy: Five paired seeds instead of one; report every seed and mean/sample standard deviation.
Genomic validation comes from training; entire official test set remains held out.
Train/development overlap with held-out inputs is removed without consulting labels.
Raw initialization and epoch sampling are paired across variants.
BF16 replaces FP16 autocast to reduce overflow; evaluation is FP32.
SN fine-tuning starts from validation-selected vanilla, not a fixed historical epoch.
Deterministic execution, checkpoint source/data hashes, per-example predictions, and resumable optimizer/RNG state are recorded.

multilayer.interpretation: Reproduce the historical architecture comparison: normalized variants also use fixed unit LayerNorm, residual scaling and QK multiplication by sqrt(head_dim). This does not isolate weight normalization or establish performance under the theorem's attention scaling.
